skill_name: Generate a summary of these two articles about the use of renewable energy.
workflow: Renewable energy is becoming increasingly popular around the world due to its many benefits. It is a clean, reliable, and sustainable source of energy that helps reduce greenhouse gas emissions and air pollution. Additionally, it is an affordable, renewable, and sustainable form of energy that can help create local jobs and promote economic growth. Renewable energy is becoming an important part of our electricity mix as it is an effective way to combat climate change.
